ann_80.original: The direct edges are a linear score on the z-scored inputs. Self-probe (typical customer): a voice-mail plan lowers the predicted risk from 3% to 1% in the whole model, the direct part moving from 0.00 to -1.04 on the logit. The 1061 training customers with a voice-mail plan churn at 7% against 17%, and the direct part's mean contribution for them is -0.75. ann_81.original: This part does two things with the evening and day charges. First, at moderate evening charges it cancels the direct evening-charge edge: that edge is 0.38 per sd, but node 103 (the evening charge above a low threshold) and its follower 12978 enter the output with negative weights. Self-probe (typical customer, evening charge swept): between 14 and 22 dollars the direct term goes from -0.28 to 0.44 while this part goes from -0.06 to -0.84, so the predicted risk stays between 3.4% and 3.2%. On the 2205 training customers where node 103 is on and node 9165 is off, the part's mean contribution is -0.45 on the logit. Second, node 9165 is a combined-bill gate: it fires when the day charge is high, and at a lower day charge when the evening charge is also high. Self-probe (typical customer, day and evening charge swept, day minutes held): at an evening charge of 26 dollars the gate is on at a day charge of 25 dollars (0.16); at the typical evening charge it is off at 35 (0.00) and on at 40 (0.07); at 8 dollars it is off at 40 (0.00) and on at 45 (0.31). At a day charge of 60 dollars the predicted risk is 31%, 47% and 89% for evening charges of 8 dollars, the typical value and 26 dollars. The gate is on for 1097 training customers, who churn at 27% against 9%, and on them the part's mean contribution is 0.36. Node 5000, a high-service-call gate that 9165 nudges through node 8513, is on for 3 training customers, of whom 100% churned: fitted to 3 rows. parts.original_hypothesis: The model's churn score is the sum of its parts on the logit, turned into a risk by a sigmoid. parts.original_hypothesis: This part does two things with the evening and day charges. First, at moderate evening charges it cancels the direct evening-charge edge: that edge is 0.38 per sd, but node 103 (the evening charge above a low threshold) and its follower 12978 enter the output with negative weights. Self-probe (typical customer, evening charge swept): between 14 and 22 dollars the direct term goes from -0.28 to 0.44 while this part goes from -0.06 to -0.84, so the predicted risk stays between 3.4% and 3.2%. On the 2205 training customers where node 103 is on and node 9165 is off, the part's mean contribution is -0.45 on the logit. Second, node 9165 is a combined-bill gate: it fires when the day charge is high, and at a lower day charge when the evening charge is also high. Self-probe (typical customer, day and evening charge swept, day minutes held): at an evening charge of 26 dollars the gate is on at a day charge of 25 dollars (0.16); at the typical evening charge it is off at 35 (0.00) and on at 40 (0.07); at 8 dollars it is off at 40 (0.00) and on at 45 (0.31). At a day charge of 60 dollars the predicted risk is 31%, 47% and 89% for evening charges of 8 dollars, the typical value and 26 dollars. The gate is on for 1097 training customers, who churn at 27% against 9%, and on them the part's mean contribution is 0.36. Node 5000, a high-service-call gate that 9165 nudges through node 8513, is on for 3 training customers, of whom 100% churned: fitted to 3 rows.
